verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Authy has an API and SDKs, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question here, but nothing in the pack mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe also records that the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. SDK availability is an adjacent developer building block, not the spec itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
